set.body: Follow-up split from P6f.5 after non-interactive Trillium authentication was unavailable on 2026-07-24. Capture exact stdout/stderr/version and checksums for: sacct --noheader --parsable2 --array --allocations --format=JobID,State,ExitCode,Reason over a real array containing successful, OOM, TIMEOUT, pending/grouped, and step rows where available. Preserve the existing authoritative contract fixture and add the site capture without claiming portability from one site.
